Rules

  • Every flyout: acrylic #2c2c2c, radius 8, 1 px black 20% stroke, 8/16 shadow, 4 px inner padding.
  • Items 36 high, 4 px radius, subtle hover fill; icon 16 at 12 px from the edge; accelerators in text 3.
  • Separators run edge to edge; group headers are caption text 3, never bold uppercase.
  • Radio items show a dot, check items a checkmark; submenus a 12 px chevron, opening on hover after 400 ms.
